The Ultimate Beach House with Private 50' Pool that Sleeps 20!!!

Location, Location, Location!!! That is what everyone says when looking for the perfect Beach Vacation Home. Always number one on the list if you could pick your Ultimate Beach Vacation House!!! Just a short walk to Rosemary Beach.

Latitudes and Attitudes, gives you the perfect location for several reasons:

-Amazing unobstructed Beach Views.
-Short one minute walk to the beach access with a handicapped accessible ramp, and bathroom and rinse off stations.
-Breathtaking Aqua Blue Views of the Gulf of Mexico from many balconies and decks.
-4 Floor Elevator.
-Huge Home with over 4500 sq. ft. of living space and 2000 sq. ft. of outdoor space.
-Total of 7 Bedrooms that comfortably Sleeps 20 Guests.
-5 Master Suite Bedrooms with Private Bathrooms, 3 of which you wake up to unobstructed Gulf Views.
-1 Very Large, Very Cool, Bunk Room with Private Bathroom, Two Bathing Areas, Big Screen TV, & Lounging Area.
-Charging Stations and/or laptop areas in all bedrooms.
-Two Master Bath Showers allow for taking in the Breathtaking Views.
-Fourth Floor Master Suite w/Soaking Tub for Two, Shower for Two, private screened in porch, Breakfast Bar, and Large deck for Sunning or Sitting in the Shade.
-Sonos Sound Speakers connected to Big Screen TV for the BIG GAME!!!
-Rare Handicap-Friendly Bedroom that can accommodate any member of your family. Located on the Third Floor, Close to Kitchen, Dining Room, and Living Room. Amazing views from this floor!!!***
-A Huge Private 50’ Pool for an Early Morning Swim or Cooling off after a Hot Day.
-Ground level Kitchen Area, Two Outdoor Showers, and a Half Bath in the Pool area.
-Chef’s Kitchen with Large Stove, Two Ovens, Two Sinks, Two Refrigerators, and Two Dishwashers. A Buffet area to serve large dinners, while looking out at the Amazing Views!!!
-Large Indoor Stone Gas Fireplace to gather around on the cool off-season evenings.
-Ground Level Under Cover area with Kitchen, Showers, & Bathroom.
-7 Off Street Parking Spaces.
-Breathtaking Aqua Blue Views of the Gulf of Mexico from many balconies and decks.
-Quiet location that is very close to the Best Restaurants, Bars, and Shopping that 30A has to offer.
-Less crowded beaches.
-Amazing Sunsets.
-Cobia Reef: Located in Inlet Beach, this reef was installed in the summer of 2017 and sits about 970 feet from the shore. The Cobia reef is comprised of 94 individual EcoSystems Reefs deployed in the shape of one of the region's most popular sport fish. To learn more about the reef please copy and paste in your browser South Walton's website below.
https://www.visitsouthwalton.com/south-waltons-snorkel-reefs

30A’s New (and Coming Soon) Restaurants and Bars, please see link below.
https://30a.com/30as-new-and-coming-soon-restaurants-and-bars/

-Easy access from Highway 98.

Need we say more??? Latitudes and Attitudes will make a perfect location for your much needed vacation to spend quality time with Family and Friends. Don’t delay. Book your Dream Vacation Today!!!

Call Endless Summer on 30a to book Latitudes & Attitudes at Inlet Beach today!

Pets are not allowed at this home.

Please don't hesitate to contact us with any questions.

We look forward to helping you plan your dream vacation!


About the Home Owner: "Latitudes and Attitudes"

Many owners along 30A name their homes based on personalities and how they present their home. After 30 years of vacationing in the warmer weather whenever possible, and enjoying the relaxed Jimmy Buffett lifestyle, the name we chose for our house was based on a song JB sings explaining the further South you go to the warm climate, your attitude becomes more relaxed, calm, and you have a peaceful state of mind. This is what we want our guests to reflect on after vacationing in Our Paradise!!!

Latitudes and Attitudes at Inlet Beach is a retreat for friends and family to gather. The amenities will be everything we have experienced in our many trips to exotic destinations throughout our life. We bring the best of what we have seen and into our properties and offer an experience to our guests that they will remember a lifetime!!!

Inlet Beach, which was once part of “Old Florida”, has now flourished into the up and coming area on the Far Eastern side of 30A. With Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach only a short walk or ride, Inlet Beach is close proximity to everything you want, but also offers the quietness of a neighborhood with little traffic and the luxurious Aqua Blue Gulf and Fine White Sandy Beach.

Our Property offers the Best Views anyone could ask for. You can see for miles in all directions from any of the three amazing decks that offer both covered protection, or sun worshiping areas, depending on your mood and “Attitude” for the day!!!

Our private pool, which is one of the largest in the area, offers an area for lap swimming, or sitting on the sun shelf with a drink and a book in your hand with the chairs located in the pool. Children of all ages will enjoy the coolness of the water in the summer or be able to swim during the off-season when the pool can be heated.

Latitudes and Attitudes is a gather place for any occasion.


Why this property:

Inlet Beach has become very popular as a Wedding Destination. With the extreme cost of Weddings at Rosemary or Alys Beach, many have chosen to gather for a Bonfire Dinner on the Beach as their rehearsal dinner, and to get married on the beach at Inlet, followed by a reception catered in the area. Our property can accommodate up to 20 persons and will give ample room for everyone to enjoy each other’s company, but also have privacy when wanted.

If you are looking for a Family Reunion, look no further. The kitchen at 220 W. Park Place Ave. is the envy of anyone who loves to cook. With 2 Refrigerators, 2 Dishwashers, 1 Large Stove/Oven plus an extra oven, and 2 Sinks, this kitchen is great to work at and have a large feast!!! Many Family Reunions, Small Intimate Weddings, Thanksgivings, & Christmas Gatherings around the Fireplace will happen here!!! The Buffet area allows for hot food set ups and families to enjoy meals together with ample room for everyone.

Shopping, Eating, and Relaxation is just a short walk or drive from our Paradise. Rosemary Beach, 30A Avenue, Seacrest Beach, and Alys are all within walking, biking, or a short drive away.


Unique Benefits:

For Families who have someone in your party that requires Handicap Friendly accommodations, look no further. Latitudes and Attitudes is one of only a few vacation homes in Inlet Beach that offers Handicap-Friendly features such as:
-Elevator from Ground level to Fourth Floor.
-One Handicap-Friendly Master Suite conveniently located on the same floor as living room, kitchen, and dining room.
-A Handicap-Friendly Bathroom featuring a roll-in Shower and bench along with a Handicap-Friendly Toilet.
-Handicap Beach Access allowing you to enjoy all the Beauty Inlet Beach has to offer.

***Please Note: The Latitudes and Attitudes Beach House strives to provide an environment that is safe, convenient, and enjoyable for guests with disabilities. However, it is not approved by the Americans with Disabilities Act, (ADA), and does not claim to be ADA approved or accessible, hence our use of the term, “Handicap-Friendly.”

Our In House Concierge Service will provide you with your needs including Bikes, Beach Chairs, Umbrellas, Bonfires, Baby, Children items, and many more!!!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
